title: Customer page and removal choices
decision: The customer's page leaves out the seller's note, the author and the payment indicator; an anonymized customer is shown to staff as Anonim plus six characters of the record identifier, leaves the customer lists, and cannot be recorded against; forgetting a person erases their Telegram identifier and revokes their sessions when no membership, other link or administrator account refers to them; a waiting removal is carried out by the payment or reversal that brings the balance to zero
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 22
rationale: BR-32 defers removal until the debt is settled; whether that is lawful is still unverified and is carried to the legal review. The label says nothing about the person and is the same in both languages
